Faire Goer

Roll d6

This faire goer... | Roll | Description | |---|---| | 1 | has been waiting for the faire all year. | | 2 | was dragged to the faire by their kids. | | 3 | is overly competitive—a sore loser and a sore winner. | | 4 | has never been to the faire before. | | 5 | traveled a long way to visit the faire. | | 6 | is obsessed with the history of dragons. |
